I sold." But revocation only covers the authority, not what the authority already set in motion. An agent that sent emails to clients, accepted terms, or merged code under your name leaves commitments that persist after you pull its keys. So there are two unwind costs: cutting off future action, which can be cheap, and unwinding past action, which often cannot be done at all. Dual authorization above thre
